name: The Legends (the white jacket)
epitaph: The trophy of the first major of The Circuit, a round robin of 2011 decided in a tie-break final; SJH won it by beating Alex Austin.

name: Prodigy Classic Championship
epitaph: The title of the one-off sixteen-man Prodigy Classic of summer 2011, run for the old Prodigy characters and won by Hornet at Madison Square Garden.
